data.one_liner: Generate PDF documents from HTML code templates in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Generates PDF documents from HTML string contents, HTML files, or HTML file paths. It supports configuration options like print size, orientation, and clickable links.
use_when: You need to generate PDF reports or documents directly from HTML strings or files
You want to convert HTML tables and text into printable/downloadable PDF files
avoid_when: You are building a complex multi-platform app requiring non-Android/iOS PDF generation (only android and ios are mentioned in platforms)
strengths: Easy conversion from HTML content, files, or file paths
Supports customization of print size, orientation, and clickable links
weaknesses: Limited platform support explicitly documented (android, ios)
Many images inside documents can significantly affect final file size
